SpanBarn — self-hosted telemetry aggregator with intelligent span retention.

Architecture: Go binary (cmd/spanbarn), SQLite + Litestream, React + Vite frontend.
Ingest: OTLP/HTTP (POST /v1/traces) and native JSON (POST /api/v1/spans).
Pipeline: in-memory queue → NDJSON spool → background worker → SQLite.
Retention: full spans for N hours, then aggregate to percentile timeseries.
Error/slow spans sampled to error_samples table.
Auth: bcrypt users + HMAC sessions + SHA256 API keys.
SDKs: JavaScript, Go, Python.

Key packages:
- internal/repository — SQLite storage (goose migrations)
- internal/ingest — non-blocking queue + handler
- internal/spool — durable NDJSON WAL
- internal/worker — spool processor
- internal/aggregation — percentile computation + bucketing
- internal/retention — span lifecycle management
- internal/api — HTTP handlers (net/http stdlib)
- internal/auth — API key + user + session auth
- internal/service — query business logic
- internal/alert — performance regression detection
- web/ — React + Vite + TypeScript dashboard
- sdks/js — @spanbarn/js npm package
- sdks/go — github.com/wiebe-xyz/spanbarn-go
- sdks/python — spanbarn PyPI package
